observed: The Narrow slit heading fits above the apparatus, without overlap or clipping.
The oblique tray has a closed rear/side/front rim outline, a front wall and two short dark support marks below it.
A thick horizontal rod enters from the left and meets an oblique paddle-like stroke on the source side.
Five incident near-parallel strokes occupy the left water region; six sampled outgoing curved fronts fan on the right from the single small opening between two screen portions.
The small near-opening curve and the larger outer fronts are visibly distinct; the outgoing family is not a continuation of the incident straight strokes.
No axes, numerical scales, wavelength values, ray arrows, labels on mathematical points or answer keys are displayed.
